#   Bitwire Aggregated IP Blocklist › Inbound
#   
#   A list of IPs/networks with a bad reputation for initiating malicious
#   connections. This includes sources of spam, scanning, brute-force attacks
#   (SSH, RDP), and web exploits.
#   
#   inbound.txt
#       List of IPs/networks with a bad reputation for initiating malicious
#       connections. This includes sources of spam, scanning, brute-force
#       attacks (SSH, RDP), and web exploits.
#   
#   outbound.txt
#       List of known malicious destination IPs. This includes C2 (Command &
#       Control) servers, botnet controllers, malware drop sites, and phishing
#       hosts.
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malicious data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
